channel.title: Inside Small Business - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Inside Small Business (insidesmallbusiness.com.au)

item.title: Franchises are beating revenue goals, but fear inflation will dampen growth
item.description: Both franchisors and franchisees are beating their revenue targets at a higher rate than the broader SME sector, according to a new survey released today.

item.title: SME owners plan to use private savings to meet PayDay Super obligations
item.description: Many SMEs plan to use their personal savings to meet compliance obligations, as late payments put pressure on their operating cash flow.

item.title: Why small businesses are choosing the City of Whittlesea
item.description: In Melbourne’s north, the City of Whittlesea is emerging as one of Victoria’s most compelling destinations for small business.

item.title: The Small Biz Fix episode 8: How to shift from employee to founder
item.description: Previously you had your role within a larger organisation - now, as a founder, you need to be on top of cashflow, marketing and compliance.

item.title: Why having a mission isn’t the same as using one
item.description: When mission statements aren’t actively referenced they lose their power but, used well, can be one of the most practical assets an SME has.

item.title: Three myths about small-business legals we need to bust right now
item.description: Well thought out small-business legals are crucial to long-term sustainable success as SMEs are more vulnerable to legal issues, not less.

item.title: ‘Resilient’ SMEs defy economy through hiring activity, report finds
item.description: A report into the hiring trends of small and medium businesses in Australia has shown resilience in the sector.

item.title: Discipline, not price, decides trade success in global turmoil
item.description: For many small businesses importing is no longer just a procurement function, it is a strategic lifeline in the commercial ecosystem.

item.title: ACMA to replace telco consumer code
item.description: Stronger consumer safeguards are on the way for Australia's telecommunications sector, with the Australian Communications and Media Authority (ACMA) set to replace the existing industry-led code with an enforceable standard.

item.title: Insolvencies near record high as global energy shock brings further risks
item.description: Business insolvencies have been near record highs since mid-2025, with higher interest rates and rising energy prices threatening to further impact cash flow, the latest data from CreditorWatch shows.

item.title: Pennie Financial opens doors for self-employed with income-focused lending
item.description: Self-employed professionals often earn more than their W-2 counterparts – but face far more obstacles when borrowing. Pennie's income-focused loan marketplace is changing that equation.

item.title: Upward bullying is rampant. But little is being done about it
item.description: New research has exposed 'upward bullying', where leaders are systematically bullied by their subordinates.

item.title: Small businesses warned of ‘opportune’ Easter scams
item.description: Small businesses across the country have been warned of “opportune” attacks from scams and cybercriminals ahead of the Easter break.

item.title: Companies reminded to meet filing obligations after Mecca fined $600,000
item.description: Three proprietary companies within Mecca have paid $594,000 in infringement notices for failing to lodge financial reports on time.

item.title: Banning card surcharges will hurt SMEs, boost prices
item.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia decision to ban card surcharges may increase cost pressure in retail, particularly for SMEs on tight margins.
